measurement_notes.fps: Independent foreground recording windows of approximately one second; mixed_context marks windows crossing modes, zones, rendering sizes or menus. Start/end contexts do not localize every individual frame; not a hardware benchmark
measurement_notes.distance: Accumulated actual camera displacement from movement commands after collision and range limits; excludes explicit position resets and teleports
measurement_notes.mode_time: Rendered foreground time with gaps capped at 1000 ms per frame
measurement_notes.sampling: Approximately 1 Hz while recording and visible; not an exact replay

limits.retention: first quarter plus most recent entries when full
